title: UCOS Ω∞ Digital-Twin Signal
description: An append-only observation ingested from an authoritative source by a connector (UKB-001). A signal updates status/metrics for a subject Universal Artifact; it never modifies identity. Rollup takes the latest signal per (subject, dimension, source). Appended by the advancement engine; part of the UKB Advancement Program (UKB-ADV-000). Modifies no existing schema.

signal_id.description: Globally unique, immutable, append-only signal id.

subject_universal_id.description: Universal Artifact this observation is about.

dimension.description: Control-tower / entity dimension this signal informs.

evidence.description: Reference/handle to the authoritative evidence (URL, report handle). Never a secret value.

metrics.description: Arbitrary numeric/string metrics (coverage, cve counts, latency, availability).

connector.description: Connector name that emitted this signal.

ingest_run.description: Ingest run id for reverse traceability.

override.description: True only for governed manual overrides (UKB-ADV-OVR).
